name: Vedha
summary: A young pickpocket who becomes protector of nine sacred books and wielder of the weapon Mirai in the 2025 Telugu film Mirai, played by Teja Sajja.
origin: Vedha Prajapati is the lead of the Telugu fantasy adventure Mirai. He is an orphan who survives by pickpocketing until he learns that he is the prophesied guardian of nine granthas that the film attributes to Emperor Ashoka. His mother Ambika keeps the ninth, Amaragrandha. To stop the villain Mahabir Lama, called Black Sword, he must wield Mirai, which the film shows to be Lord Rama's bow, Kodanda, guarded by the eagle Sampati.
creators: T. G. Vishwa Prasad and Krithi Prasad (producers)
powers: Karra Samu stick fighting with a staff weapon called a Yo

storyline.title: The orphan thief
storyline.beat: Vedha lives by pickpocketing until he finds out he is the chosen protector of nine sacred scriptures.

storyline.title: The Black Sword hunts
storyline.beat: Mahabir Lama takes eight books and seeks the ninth, Amaragrandha, which Vedha's mother guards.

storyline.title: Seeking Mirai
storyline.beat: Vedha travels to claim the weapon Mirai, guarded by the eagle Sampati, to face Mahabir.

storyline.title: Jaithraya
storyline.beat: A mid-credits scene with a Midas-touch stranger sets up the sequel Mirai: Jaithraya.

gossip.text: Prabhas narrates the film in voice-over, and Rana Daggubati cameos as the man with the Midas touch in the mid-credits scene.
Mirai was first set to release on 18 April 2025, then postponed to 12 September 2025.
Mirai was announced on 18 April 2024 with a title promo and first-look poster, exactly a year before its first planned release date of 18 April 2025.
Mirai is a retelling of the Ramayana.
gossip.truth: It borrows Rama's bow and the eagle Sampati from the Ramayana tradition, but it tells a new story about Vedha and the nine granthas.

quiz.q: What is the weapon Mirai revealed to be?
quiz.why: The film shows Mirai to be the bow of Lord Rama.

quiz.q: How many sacred books does Vedha protect?
quiz.why: He is guardian of the nine granthas.

quiz.q: In the Ramayana tradition, who is Sampati's younger brother?
quiz.why: Sampati is the elder brother of Jatayu, the vulture who tried to rescue Sita.

theme.tagline: An orphan thief with a sacred bow.

timeline.title: Teaser
timeline.note: The first teaser arrives on 28 May 2025, ahead of the postponed September release.

timeline.title: Release
timeline.note: Mirai opens worldwide on 12 September 2025, after being postponed from its first date, 18 April 2025.

timeline.title: Hit at 60 crore budget
timeline.note: It earns roughly Rs 141 to 150 crore and ranks among Telugu cinema's top grossers of 2025.

timeline.title: Streaming debut
timeline.note: JioHotstar begins streaming it on 10 October 2025 in Telugu, with dubbed Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam versions.

timeline.title: INCA awards
timeline.note: It wins Best Film (Telugu) and Best VFX at the 2026 Indian National Cine Academy Awards.

timeline.title: Japan release
timeline.note: Mirai opens in Japan on 21 August 2026 after strong day-one advance bookings, ahead of several big Indian titles.

facts.text: In the film's story, Emperor Ashoka poured his powers into nine granthas after the Kalinga War; the books can turn mortals into deities, and Vedha is their prophesied protector.
The film reveals the weapon Mirai to be the Kodanda, the bow of Lord Rama, drawing on the Ramayana for its biggest twist.

In the Valmiki Ramayana tradition Sampati, who guards Mirai here, is the elder brother of Jatayu. Hindu tradition says his wings burned when he shielded Jatayu from the sun, and he then lived in the Vindhya mountains.

In the Ramayana tradition Sampati waited about eight millennia until Hanuman's search party arrived. His sight told them Sita was in Lanka, his wings grew back, and he performed Jatayu's funeral rites.
Shooting in the Himalayas took about three days at minus 18 C; even in boots and thermal layers it felt like needles in his feet, Teja Sajja said.
The eagle Sampati is not fully computer-generated: a remote-controlled animatronic bird was built for the film by a Mumbai specialist, who the director says is the only animatronics worker in India.
No pool was big enough for the bird, so the underwater Sampati scene was filmed in separate pieces and scaled to match; the director called it his proudest cheat.
In the mid-credits scene the Midas-touch man wants Mirai for riches and vows to bring in this age the justice that Treta Yuga, the Ramayana's age, refused; it sets up the sequel Mirai: Jaithraya.

Outlook's early look shows Vedha as a Super Yodha on an erupting volcano under an eclipse, with a title logo in a Japanese-style font. It says he excels at Karra Samu stick fights with a staff weapon called a Yo.
The film lists Jayaram as the sage Agasthya Muni. In the Ramayana, as Wikipedia retells it, sage Agastya gives Rama's party a divine bow and arrow, an echo of Rama's bow at the film's heart.
Vedha's mother Ambika Prajapati, played by Shriya Saran, is the protector of Amaragrandha, the ninth and strongest grantha, and the plot reveals Vedha to be her son.
The villain Mahabir Lama, played by Manchu Manoj, leads a group called the Black Sword. He captures eight of the nine granthas but fails to get Amaragrandha, the ninth and strongest.
Composer Gowra Hari, fresh from Hanu-Man, scored Mirai. The singles were 'Vibe Undi', sung by Armaan Malik, and 'Jaithraya', sung by Shankar Mahadevan, which came out four days before release.
The sequel is titled Mirai: Jaithraya, the same word as the second single sung by Shankar Mahadevan, and Rana Daggubati cameos as the Midas-touch man who sets it up.
The shorter OTT cut on JioHotstar runs about 2 hours 46 minutes against the 2 hour 49 minute theatrical version, and the song 'Vibe Undhi Baby' is missing from it.
Filming took place at Ramoji Film City, in Sri Lanka and at other Hyderabad locations, and the night shoots for the talkie portions ended in December 2024.
The budget reportedly rose from about Rs 30 to 40 crore to around Rs 60 crore because of the heavy VFX and plans for a pan-India release.
Producer T. G. Vishwa Prasad cites nearly 2,000 VFX shots from artists in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Mumbai, singles out the life-like Sampati bird, and says it passed Rs 40 crore in three days.

The Mirai trailer runs 3 minutes 10 seconds, yet the divine element shows for only about 10 seconds. Sajja calls the film a commercial one with fantasy, adventure and emotion rather than an educational one.
Karthik Gattamneni wrote and directed Mirai and also worked as its cinematographer, so one filmmaker shaped both the story and the look of the film.
Before its Japan release, Mirai entered the top ten Indian films for day-one advance bookings there, ahead of Dhurandhar 2. Hanu-Man had reportedly earned about Rs 1 crore in Japan.

kidSummary: Vedha is an orphan who survives by picking pockets until he learns he is the chosen guardian of nine sacred books. To stop a villain called the Black Sword he must find the weapon Mirai, which the film shows to be Rama's bow, guarded by a giant divine eagle called Sampati.
